notes:
Lead source: organic inbound (blog post + product comparison). Small telehealth startup focused on chat-first intake and care-coordination for behavioral health clinics.

Key ask: want to use Hosted API (self-serve) for chat triage & summarization but need clear answers on what Redwood persists, retention controls, and whether PHI can be prevented from being stored. Quote from CEO on call: "We need confidence that notes and identifiers aren't retained longer than our retention policy — 30 days ideally."

Security / compliance summary (customer language):
- HIPAA-adjacent (not signed BAA yet) — they handle some PHI but are trying to de-identify at the client before sending.
- Asks: retention controls, opt-out of telemetry, redact on ingest, KMS or bring-your-own-key for critical fields, audit logs for admin access.
- Not enterprise procurement; small legal team, needs plain-language docs to take to counsel.

Technical notes from SE call (Ravi):
- Typical request size: short chat messages (avg 200 tokens); peak concurrent users ~30, expected scale 50 req/s in future if growth.
- Latency target: <= 400ms 90p for triage path; lower priority for longer summarization jobs.
- Cost sensitivity high; need per-token estimates and guidelines for batching or cheaper open models.
- Interested in Redwood's prefix caching and batching suggestions to save cost.

POC ask: provide self-serve sandbox with free credits + sample redaction pipeline (client-side and server-side examples). Want a short runbook showing how to avoid persisting PHI in Redwood Hosted API and guidance on TTL/retention settings.

Sales cadence: early discovery -> SE deep dive -> legal FAQ -> small POC (2 weeks) -> decide on monthly usage commit.

Stated objections: 
- "Does Redwood store the raw request?" (Need explicit answer + retention TTL controls)
- Pricing predictability for 10-50k tokens/month
- Need a light-weight BAA conversation but not full enterprise onboarding yet.

Action items (assigned):
- AE (Jordan): send quickstart + link to free credits, include plain-language retention FAQ (by 2026-03-12).
- SE (Ravi): prepare redaction example (client + server) and sample config for TTL controls; attach small benchmark for latency on small models (by 2026-03-15).
- Legal: provide template BAA escalation path (deferred until POC looks good).

Internal notes: prioritize a crisp one-pager showing Hosted API retention options (no storage, short TTL, opt-out telemetry) — this is main blocker for small legal team. Keep messaging simple — they will likely self-serve if answers are clear and sample code is available.
